title: Mochiichao item record (#31)
description: Flat item registry record: category/pocket, structured effect naming its wired consumer system, use contexts, price slots. ITEMS ARE NOT MOVES: this schema deliberately has NO move-class field — General/Rare are move classes (owner-named, PR #366 registry) and additionalProperties:false makes conflating the two systems a schema error, not a convention. An item may REFERENCE a move id inside effect.params; it never carries a class.

displayName.description: Rename-law string. Canon already holds e.g. 'Mochi Fruit', 'Mochi Cocoon' as names (display sweep) — their records instance only when a citable canon source fixes category/effect.

category.description: Closed vocabulary. A new category is a schema revision, never a free string.

system.description: The wired consumer: status -> #27 condition records, care -> #28 activities/axes, event -> #12 flags, field -> battle field hooks.

params.description: Values null until a balance/canon source sets them.

safari.description: #170 (List 18): safari-zone usability flag, proposed into this schema at the List 18 landing citing #170. No item is flagged by the landing; bait legality stays vacuous until item content exists.

buy.description: Economy numbers are the List 3 #20 pass; slots live here so the registry never reshapes.

meaning.description: Item-meaning layer (item-meaning lane S-IM1, 2026-10-29): OPTIONAL and backwards-compatible — a record without it is a plain item. provenance = where it was made/found and by whom (existing canon only); appraisal = the fossil-service shape (a find is unidentified until a research seat names it); keepsake = a gift whose giver is part of the record (depth derives from the keepsake fact log on the bond band scale, never a stored number); unique = one-of-one discipline (exactly one mechEffect + one storyEffect, hand-placed, never shop stock or drop rows — guarded by src/lib/itemMeaning.test.ts). New relic display names carry draftName until the owner rules.
